steps: Heat the oil, add the cumin and let it sizzle.
Add the chopped onion and green chilli and fry until light golden.
Stir in the ginger and garlic and cook for a minute.
Add the chopped tomato and cook until soft and oil shows at the edges.
Stir in the turmeric, chilli powder, coriander powder and salt for a minute.
Add all the chopped vegetables and the peas and stir-fry for 3 minutes.
Pour in about a cup of hot water for four people, cover and cook on medium-low until the vegetables are tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in the cream and garam masala, top with coriander leaves and serve.
note: One recipe used about 90 g of vegetables a person and the other about 130 g; this follows the larger one, a fair share for a main vegetable dish.
